sloka: तृणबिन्दुस्तु राजर्षिस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभः ।ध्यानं विवेश तच्चापि ह्यपश्यदृषिकर्मजम् ।। ७.२.२३ ॥
transliteration: tṛṇabindustu rājarṣistapasā dyotitaprabhaḥ ।dhyānaṁ viveśa taccāpi hyapaśyadṛṣikarmajam ।। 7.2.23 ॥

translations.english: The royal sage Tṛṇabindu, whose splendor was illuminated by his penance, then entered into meditation and indeed perceived that the transformation was due to a sage's action.
translations.hindi: त्रिशिरा, अतिकाय, देवान्तक और नरान्तक जैसे महा बलवान राक्षसा को हे राम ! देवात्‌ ही तुमने मार गिराया है
